verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Hummingbird as a case-management and filing platform. It ingests alerts from external monitoring systems via the Alerts API and mentions screening customers. Nothing documents screening a payment before release or returning a decision with supporting matches. Receiving alerts from other monitoring tools is adjacent functionality, not first-party pre-release payment screening.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can screen a payment before release and inspect the decision and its supporting matches
